facts.business: AIA Engineering Limited manufactures high-chrome mill internals (grinding media and mill liners) and provides integrated grinding solutions for mining, cement, and utility sectors globally.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Dividend policy is to distribute 10-25% of its consolidated net profit as dividend
Capital expenditure plan over the medium term shall be largely funded through internal accruals

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No qualification / observation in the report

key_risks: Stability in mining market particularly copper and gold
Financial risks from foreign currency fluctuation and tax landscape
Trade barriers by various countries including anti-dumping duties
Disruption in supply chain and logistics
Compliance risks across different regulatory landscapes
Environmental, Social and Governance risks including climate-related events
Business continuity risks from natural disasters, pandemics, cyberattacks
facts.related_party_note: All Related Party Transactions entered during the financial year were on an Arm's Length basis and in the Ordinary Course of Business. No materially significant Related Party Transactions made by the Company with Promoters, Directors, KMP which may have a potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large. Prior Omnibus approval of the Audit Committee is obtained on yearly basis for foreseen and repetitive transactions.
